question: Aditi Mangaldas is a leading dancer \& Choreographer in the classical Indian dance form of _____.
solution:
Correct Answer **Kathak**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points:__**

__
 
• Aditi Mangaldas is a leading dancer and choreographer in Kathak, a classical Indian dance form.
 
• She has received extensive training from renowned gurus Shrimati Kumudini Lakhia and Pandit Birju Maharaj.
 
• Aditi is recognized for her exceptional artistry, technique, and eloquence in every performance.
 
• Her characteristic energy sets her apart and adds a unique touch to her dance.
 
• Aditi Mangaldas is highly acclaimed and respected in the field of Kathak.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**Classical dance

 
• Classical dances are performed by professional or highly trained dancers who have studied their form for many years.
 
• There are eight classical Dances in India.
 
• Classical dance expresses a story or theme and this form of art lies in the religious Hindu music theatre styles. It represents the culture.
 
• They are
 
 
• Kathak from North India,
 
• Sattriya of Assam,
 
• Bharatnatyam of Tamil Nadu,
 
• Kuchipudi of Andhra Pradesh,
 
• Kathakali and Mohiniaattam of Kerala,
 
• Manipuri of Northeast India, and
 
• Odissi of Odisha.
 
 
 
• It is the right way to connect with your feelings, coordinate and move the movement skills and build strength and stability in your body.
